more_info.overview: Extracts of rosemary is used as an antioxidant in food. Its technological role is to slow oxidation in food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include vegetable oil pan spray, fats and oils essentially free from water  (excluding anhydrous milk fat), fruit and vegetable preparations excluding compote, nut butters and nut spreads. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 0–0.6 mg/kg body weight (expressed as carnosic acid and carnosol) (JECFA, 2025).
more_info.origin: Extracted from rosemary leaves. The preparation contains antioxidant phenolic compounds, including diterpenes.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
